text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, my friends! What are you guys up to?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We're about to have a party together! If 
you'd like, Taiki, want to join us?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, let's go— Oh... today is 
training day, indeed."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I see... I went and ordered an extra-large 
pizza and everything, but if that's how it 
is, it can't be helped~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... there's still time until training. 
Maybe just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! More importantly, let's get 
going!
